pois.label: SiC 探测舱(剖切)
pois.detail: 与围界哨兵(sci-rad-02)同款探测叠层的室内瘦身版:慢化片 → ⁶LiF 30 µm 转换层 → 4H-SiC PiN 片 2×2(热道/快道)→ 铜读出板 → 前放。宽禁带 3.26 eV 盲可见光——玄关的常亮灯光对它是不存在的,所以剖面可以敞着给你看。
pois.detail_en: The indoor slim version of the perimeter sentinel's stack (sci-rad-02): moderator slab → 30 µm ⁶LiF converter → 2×2 4H-SiC PiN pads (thermal/fast channels) → copper readout → preamp. The 3.26 eV bandgap is visible-blind — the foyer's always-on lighting simply does not exist for it, which is why the cutaway can stay open for you to look at.

specs.SiC 片: 4×1 cm²,50 µm 外延 PiN(LGAD 同外延栈,免增益层)
specs.转换层: ⁶LiF 30 µm(**95% ⁶Li 富集**),效率 4.7%(峰值厚度)
specs.冷却/遮光: 均无需(账4:300 K 生成电流比 Si 低 ~18 个数量级)

specs_en.SiC pads: 4×1 cm², 50 µm epi PiN (LGAD-lineage stack, gain implant omitted)
specs_en.Converter: ⁶LiF 30 µm (**95% ⁶Li enriched**), 4.7% efficiency (peak thickness)
specs_en.Cooling/light-tightening: neither needed (account #4: generation current ~18 decades below Si at 300 K)

pois.sim: 器件账引 LGAD L2a TCAD:600 V 反向 IV 全程 1e-31 A/µm(漏电低到 BV 无法从 IV 读出);V_fd=116 V @5e13/50 µm,工作偏压 ~120 V。
pois.sim_en: Device account from LGAD L2a TCAD: reverse IV flat at 1e-31 A/µm to 600 V (leakage too low to even read breakdown off the IV); V_fd=116 V @5e13/50 µm, ~120 V operating bias.
pois.physics: ⁶Li(n,α)t Q=4.78 MeV,产物在 SiC 里生成 ~26 万 e-h 对——信号比 MIP 大两个量级,PiN 无增益即可数脉冲;同一次 TCAD 战役的增益版(d17,M≈5)属于轨道上的 PAN 谱仪。
pois.physics_en: ⁶Li(n,α)t, Q=4.78 MeV; the products make ~260k e-h pairs in SiC — two orders above a MIP, so a gainless PiN counts pulses cleanly; the gain variant from the same TCAD campaign (d17, M≈5) belongs to the orbital PAN spectrometer.

pois.label: 计数屏 · 30 m 岩之下
pois.label_en: Count display · under 30 m of rock
pois.detail: 这块屏偶尔才跳一下。玄关顶上 30 m 岩石(7800 g/cm²)等于 52 个强子衰减长度——地表的宇宙线强子成分在这里被杀绝,剩下能敲响它的几乎只有穿深极强的 µ 子和建材里的微量放射性。
pois.detail_en: This screen only blips once in a while. The 30 m of rock overhead (7800 g/cm²) is 52 hadronic attenuation lengths — the surface cosmic-ray hadrons are annihilated here, and about the only things left to ring it are deeply penetrating muons and trace radioactivity in the building materials.

specs.覆盖: 30 m 岩 = 7800 g/cm²(按 ρ=2.6 g/cm³ 基岩;邻卡 hab-quarter-01 以 >5000 g/cm² 下界写法记同一层)
specs.µ 道: ×0.03 残余 → ~83 s 一跳(带电道有效面积 8 cm²)
specs.屏显节奏: ~45 s(µ + 建材/环境 γ 合并计数)

specs_en.Overburden: 30 m rock = 7800 g/cm² (at ρ=2.6 g/cm³ bedrock; the neighbouring hab-quarter-01 card records the same layer as a >5000 g/cm² lower bound)
specs_en.µ channel: ×0.03 residual → ~83 s per blip (8 cm² charged-channel area)

pois.sim: 三层深度衰减账(design_rounds 账3):地表 GCR 带电 ~0.05 /cm²/s → 30 m 岩后 µ ×0.03 → 8 cm² 有效面积 ~1.2e-2 cps;GCR 中子 0.05 → radiogenic 底 1e-5 n/cm²/s(降 3.7 个数量级)。围界同款柱在地表跳 2.32 cps——差出来的就是头顶这层岩。
pois.sim_en: Depth-attenuation account (design_rounds #3): surface GCR charged ~0.05 /cm²/s → ×0.03 muon residual after 30 m → ~1.2e-2 cps over the 8 cm² charged-channel area; GCR neutrons 0.05 → radiogenic floor 1e-5 n/cm²/s (3.7 decades down). The identical column blips at 2.32 cps up at the fence (resolved chain) — the difference is the rock overhead.
pois.physics: 强子按 λ≈150 g/cm² 指数消失,µ 只能靠电离损失慢慢磨——所以浅地下的计数几乎全是 µ 子在说话。这也是居住区把自己埋进岩里的全部理由:GCR 剂量与这块屏一起被埋掉了。
pois.physics_en: Hadrons die exponentially with λ≈150 g/cm²; muons only grind down by ionization — so shallow-underground counts are almost entirely muons talking. Which is also the whole reason the habitat buried itself: the GCR dose was buried together with this screen.

pois.label: 哨兵网中层 · 三层联动
pois.label_en: Mid tier of the sentinel net
pois.detail: 哨兵网的中间一层:围界柱(地表)每 ~0.43 s 一跳,这根柱 ~1 分钟偶尔一跳,深地那根(3000 m)几乎纹丝不动。三块同款屏,读数差出 5 个数量级——静默就是屏蔽账的活体证明。太阳粒子事件里这根柱子的价值恰恰在于它不动:警报来自天上(EVA 提前量只由 com-l4-01 日冕仪那一级买到,1–3 天;EPS 的 ~77 min 是自由空间谱弥散间隔,不是地表余量),地表围界柱随即证实次级场到达,而头顶 30 m 岩让这块屏读数纹丝不变——住在这里的人此刻的剂量增量,就是这块屏上那个没有发生的变化。
pois.detail_en: The middle tier of the net: the fence column (surface) blips every ~0.43 s (**re-anchored 2026-09-02; the old ~12 s was the assumed-2 m case**), this one blips maybe once a minute, and the deep-lab one (3000 m) barely moves at all. Three identical screens, five decades apart — the silence is the shielding budget, alive. During a solar particle event this column's worth lies precisely in not moving: the warning comes from orbit (evacuation lead time comes only from the com-l4-01 coronagraph, 1–3 days; the polar EPS's ~77 min is a free-space dispersion interval, not ground margin), the surface column then confirms the secondary field has arrived, and the 30 m of rock overhead leaves this screen unchanged — the dose increment for the people living here is exactly the change that fails to happen on this display.

specs.上层: sci-rad-02 围界 2.32 cps(已分辨口径)

sim: 对表:地表→玄关中子降 ~3.7 个数量级(强子 e^-52 后剩 radiogenic 底),µ 降 ~30×;玄关→深地 µ 再压 ~3e4(至 ×1e-6,对表 sci-deeplab-01 竖井卡),中子再降 ~10× 到裸岩极限。
SEP 零响应账(design_rounds 账5):地表次级场增强 F 倍时(F=2~1e4 全档),本柱读数变化 <1%、测不出来——SEP 质子最高 ~GeV,其次级强子在 30 m 岩里同样过 52 个 e 折长度,且火星薄大气本就几乎不产穿透 µ。围界 ×F 对本柱 ×1,这一对读数就是避难深度的实测衰减下限。
(**2026-09-02 换锚**:围界由自设 2 m 屏蔽档换到 tokamak 已声明的**建造厚度 0.30 m 已分辨面**;旧值 0.08 cps / 12 s 已作废,详见 sci-rad-02 卡。)
sim_en: Cross-table: surface→foyer, neutrons drop ~3.7 decades (radiogenic floor after the e^-52 hadron kill) and muons ~30×; foyer→deep lab, muons fall another ~3e4 (to ×1e-6, matching the sci-deeplab-01 shaft card) and neutrons another ~10× to the bare-rock limit.

SEP zero-response account (design_rounds #5): for surface enhancements of F=2 to 1e4, this column's reading changes by <1% and is unmeasurable — SEP protons top out around a GeV, their secondaries cross the same 52 hadronic e-folds in 30 m of rock, and Mars's thin atmosphere barely makes penetrating muons in the first place. Fence ×F against this column ×1 is the measured lower bound on shelter attenuation.
(**Re-anchored 2026-09-02**: the fence moved from the assumed-2 m shield to tokamak’s declared **0.30 m build thickness, resolved face**; the old 0.08 cps / 12 s are void — see the sci-rad-02 card.)
pois.physics: 同一根柱子换三个深度,计数率就是深度-强度曲线本身:探测器不变,变的只有头顶的物质柱密度。
pois.physics_en: One column at three depths turns the count rate into the depth-intensity curve itself: the detector never changes, only the column density overhead does.
